query: Describe municipal/local government in Pakistan: the generic name of local units and how many exist, the governing council and its offices (for example municipal president/mayor, trustees, councillors) with how each office is filled and its term length. Then list the current heads of the 10 most populous municipalities as of 2026-11-14: municipality name, the first-level division it belongs to, head title in English and local language, how the head is selected, and the current officeholder (full name, party, term start/end) with source URLs. Exclude sub-units of the national capital if the capital is governed differently.

units.name: Peshawar
units.head_title_en: Administrator of the Capital Metropolitan Government

offices.selection_details: Sindh and Punjab 2025: council elects the head indirectly; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa city/tehsil heads are elected directly. Balochistan metropolitan head is designated mayor and elected by council. Sindh and KP councils serve four years; Punjab 2025 councils five years. No uniform national tenure.
Elected by the council under provincial local-government laws; number of deputies varies by type and province. Council term: four years in Sindh and KP, five years under Punjab 2025.

General local-council seats are directly elected; reserved seats are generally indirectly elected; in Punjab 2025, union-council chairpersons sit ex officio in higher councils. Provincial term lengths differ (Sindh/KP four years, Punjab 2025 five years).
Provincial government appoints/authorizes an official to exercise council or head powers pending a newly elected council; no fixed elected term.

structured_output.unit_name_en: Local government (municipal corporation, town corporation, municipal committee, tehsil council or union council, depending on province)
structured_output.council_name_en: Local council (municipal or metropolitan corporation council; tehsil, town or union council according to locality)

text: Pakistan has no single nationwide municipality type, uniform council term, or reliable current national unit count: provincial laws differ. The ten largest cities outside differently governed Islamabad are ranked using the 2023 census, with Sargodha replacing Islamabad. As of 14 November 2026, Karachi and Hyderabad have elected mayors; the other eight listed municipal governments are headed by appointed administrators. Punjab’s 2025 framework provides five-year elected councils, whereas Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa prescribe four-year councils. Administrator appointment dates and end dates are left blank where not established by the cited sources; the Gujranwala and Multan administrators are identified by combining the province-wide deputy-commissioner appointment policy with contemporary reports naming their deputy commissioners.
